turns.reply: I added `frontend(path, *, directory, name=None)` to both `FastAPI` (`fastapi/applications.py`) and `APIRouter` (`fastapi/routing.py`). It mounts a `StaticFiles(directory=..., html=True)` at the path, so `/` serves `index.html` and subdirectories serve their own `index.html`. I checked this with a quick script (root and subdirectory requests, plus `APIRouter.frontend` included into an app) and the existing static-files tests pass. I also moved the new method above `on_event`'s `@deprecated` decorator, so that decorator stays on `on_event`.
